classes.label: Agent
classes.comment: A resource that acts or has the power to act.

classes.label: Agent Class
classes.comment: A group of agents.

classes.label: Bibliographic Resource
classes.comment: A book, article, or other documentary resource.

classes.label: File Format
classes.comment: A digital resource format.

classes.label: Frequency
classes.comment: A rate at which something recurs.

classes.label: Jurisdiction
classes.comment: The extent or range of judicial, law enforcement, or other authority.

classes.label: License Document
classes.comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with a Resource.

classes.label: Linguistic System
classes.comment: A system of signs, symbols, sounds, gestures, or rules used in communication.

classes.label: Location
classes.comment: A spatial region or named place.

classes.label: Location, Period, or Jurisdiction
classes.comment: A location, period of time, or jurisdiction.

classes.label: Media Type
classes.comment: A file format or physical medium.

classes.label: Media Type or Extent
classes.comment: A media type or extent.

classes.label: Method of Instruction
classes.comment: A process that is used to engender knowledge, attitudes, and skills.

classes.label: Method of Accrual
classes.comment: A method by which resources are added to a collection.

classes.label: Period of Time
classes.comment: An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end dates.

classes.label: Physical Medium
classes.comment: A physical material or carrier.

classes.label: Physical Resource
classes.comment: A material thing.

classes.label: Policy
classes.comment: A plan or course of action by an authority, intended to influence and determine decisions, actions, and other matters.

classes.label: Provenance Statement
classes.comment: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of a resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

classes.label: Rights Statement
classes.comment: A statement about the intellectual property rights (IPR) held in or over a Resource, a legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource, or a statement about access rights.

classes.label: Size or Duration
classes.comment: A dimension or extent, or a time taken to play or execute.

classes.label: Standard
classes.comment: A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated.

properties.label: Title
properties.comment: A name given to the resource.

properties.label: Creator
properties.comment: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

properties.label: Subject
properties.comment: The topic of the resource.

properties.label: Description
properties.comment: An account of the resource.

properties.label: Publisher
properties.comment: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

properties.label: Contributor
properties.comment: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.

properties.label: Date
properties.comment: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

properties.label: Type
properties.comment: The nature or genre of the resource.

properties.label: Format
properties.comment: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

properties.label: Identifier
properties.comment: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

properties.label: Source
properties.comment: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

properties.label: Language
properties.comment: A language of the resource.

properties.label: Relation
properties.comment: A related resource.

properties.label: Coverage
properties.comment: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, the spatial applicability of the resource, or the jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

properties.label: Rights
properties.comment: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

properties.label: Audience
properties.comment: A class of entity for whom the resource is intended or useful.

properties.label: Alternative Title
properties.comment: An alternative name for the resource.

properties.label: Table Of Contents
properties.comment: A list of subunits of the resource.

properties.label: Abstract
properties.comment: A summary of the resource.

properties.label: Date Created
properties.comment: Date of creation of the resource.

properties.label: Date Valid
properties.comment: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.

properties.label: Date Available
properties.comment: Date (often a range) that the resource became or will become available.

properties.label: Date Issued
properties.comment: Date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the resource.

properties.label: Date Modified
properties.comment: Date on which the resource was changed.

properties.label: Extent
properties.comment: The size or duration of the resource.

properties.label: Medium
properties.comment: The material or physical carrier of the resource.

properties.label: Is Version Of
properties.comment: A related resource of which the described resource is a version, edition, or adaptation.

properties.label: Has Version
properties.comment: A related resource that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described resource.

properties.label: Is Replaced By
properties.comment: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.

properties.label: Replaces
properties.comment: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource.

properties.label: Is Required By
properties.comment: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

properties.label: Requires
properties.comment: A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

properties.label: Is Part Of
properties.comment: A related resource in which the described resource is physically or logically included.

properties.label: Has Part
properties.comment: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.

properties.label: Is Referenced By
properties.comment: A related resource that references, cites, or otherwise points to the described resource.

properties.label: References
properties.comment: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

properties.label: Is Format Of
properties.comment: A related resource that is substantially the same as the described resource, but in another format.

properties.label: Has Format
properties.comment: A related resource that is substantially the same as the pre-existing described resource, but in another format.

properties.label: Conforms To
properties.comment: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.

properties.label: Spatial Coverage
properties.comment: Spatial characteristics of the resource.

properties.label: Temporal Coverage
properties.comment: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

properties.label: Mediator
properties.comment: An entity that mediates access to the resource and for whom the resource is intended or useful.

properties.label: Date Accepted
properties.comment: Date of acceptance of the resource.

properties.label: Date Copyrighted
properties.comment: Date of copyright.

properties.label: Date Submitted
properties.comment: Date of submission of the resource.

properties.label: Audience Education Level
properties.comment: A class of entity, defined in terms of progression through an educational or training context, for which the described resource is intended.

properties.label: Access Rights
properties.comment: Information about who can access the resource or an indication of its security status.

properties.label: Bibliographic Citation
properties.comment: A bibliographic reference for the resource.

properties.label: License
properties.comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

properties.label: Rights Holder
properties.comment: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource.

properties.label: Provenance
properties.comment: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

properties.label: Instructional Method
properties.comment: A process, used to engender knowledge, attitudes and skills, that the described resource is designed to support.

properties.label: Accrual Method
properties.comment: The method by which items are added to a collection.

properties.label: Accrual Periodicity
properties.comment: The frequency with which items are added to a collection.

properties.label: Accrual Policy
properties.comment: The policy governing the addition of items to a collection.

classes.label: Collection
classes.comment: An aggregation of resources.

classes.label: Dataset
classes.comment: Data encoded in a defined structure.

classes.label: Event
classes.comment: A non-persistent, time-based occurrence.

classes.label: Image
classes.comment: A visual representation other than text.

classes.label: Interactive Resource
classes.comment: A resource requiring interaction from the user to be understood, executed, or experienced.

classes.label: Service
classes.comment: A system that provides one or more functions.

classes.label: Software
classes.comment: A computer program in source or compiled form.

classes.label: Sound
classes.comment: A resource primarily intended to be heard.

classes.label: Text
classes.comment: A resource consisting primarily of words for reading.

classes.label: Physical Object
classes.comment: An inanimate, three-dimensional object or substance.

classes.label: Still Image
classes.comment: A static visual representation.

classes.label: Moving Image
classes.comment: A series of visual representations imparting an impression of motion when shown in succession.

classes.label: Academic Article
classes.comment: A scholarly academic article, typically published in a journal.

classes.label: Article
classes.comment: A written composition in prose, usually nonfiction, on a specific topic, forming an independent part of a book or other publication, as a newspaper or magazine.

classes.label: audio document
classes.comment: An audio document; aka record.

classes.label: audio-visual document
classes.comment: An audio-visual document; film, video, and so forth.

classes.label: Bill
classes.comment: Draft legislation presented for discussion to a legal body.

classes.label: Book
classes.comment: A written or printed work of fiction or nonfiction, usually on sheets of paper fastened or bound together within covers.

classes.label: Book Section
classes.comment: A section of a book.

classes.label: Brief
classes.comment: A written argument submitted to a court.

classes.label: Chapter
classes.comment: A chapter of a book.

classes.label: Code
classes.comment: A collection of statutes.

classes.label: Collected Document
classes.comment: A document that simultaneously contains other documents.

classes.label: Collection
classes.comment: A collection of Documents or Collections

classes.label: Conference
classes.comment: A meeting for consultation or discussion.

classes.label: Court Reporter
classes.comment: A collection of legal cases.

classes.label: Document
classes.comment: A document (noun) is a bounded physical representation of body of information designed with the capacity (and usually intent) to communicate. A document may manifest symbolic, diagrammatic or sensory-representational information.

classes.label: document part
classes.comment: a distinct part of a larger document or collected document.

classes.label: Document Status
classes.comment: The status of the publication of a document.

classes.label: Edited Book
classes.comment: An edited book.

classes.label: EMail
classes.comment: A written communication addressed to a person or organization and transmitted electronically.

classes.label: Excerpt
classes.comment: A passage selected from a larger work.

classes.label: Film
classes.comment: aka movie.

classes.label: Hearing
classes.comment: An instance or a session in which testimony and arguments are presented, esp. before an official, as a judge in a lawsuit.

classes.label: Image
classes.comment: A document that presents visual or diagrammatic information.

classes.label: Interview
classes.comment: A formalized discussion between two or more people.

classes.label: Issue
classes.comment: something that is printed or published and distributed, esp. a given number of a periodical

classes.label: Journal
classes.comment: A periodical of scholarly journal Articles.

classes.label: Legal Case Document
classes.comment: A document accompanying a legal case.

classes.label: Decision
classes.comment: A document containing an authoritative determination (as a decree or judgment) made after consideration of facts or law.

classes.label: Legal Document
classes.comment: A legal document; for example, a court decision, a brief, and so forth.

classes.label: Legislation
classes.comment: A legal document proposing or enacting a law or a group of laws.

classes.label: Letter
classes.comment: A written or printed communication addressed to a person or organization and usually transmitted by mail.

classes.label: Magazine
classes.comment: A periodical of magazine Articles. A magazine is a publication that is issued periodically, usually bound in a paper cover, and typically contains essays, stories, poems, etc., by many writers, and often photographs and drawings, frequently specializing in a particular subject or area, as hobbies, news, or sports.

classes.label: Manual
classes.comment: A small reference book, especially one giving instructions.

classes.label: Manuscript
classes.comment: An unpublished Document, which may also be submitted to a publisher for publication.

classes.label: Map
classes.comment: A graphical depiction of geographic features.

classes.label: Multivolume Book
classes.comment: A loose, thematic, collection of Documents, often Books.

classes.label: Newspaper
classes.comment: A periodical of documents, usually issued daily or weekly, containing current news, editorials, feature articles, and usually advertising.

classes.label: Note
classes.comment: Notes or annotations about a resource.

classes.label: Patent
classes.comment: A document describing the exclusive right granted by a government to an inventor to manufacture, use, or sell an invention for a certain number of years.

classes.label: Performance
classes.comment: A public performance.

classes.label: Periodical
classes.comment: A group of related documents issued at regular intervals.

classes.label: Personal Communication
classes.comment: A communication between an agent and one or more specific recipients.

classes.label: Personal Communication Document
classes.comment: A personal communication manifested in some document.

classes.label: Proceedings
classes.comment: A compilation of documents published from an event, such as a conference.

classes.label: Quote
classes.comment: An excerpted collection of words.

classes.label: Reference Source
classes.comment: A document that presents authoritative reference information, such as a dictionary or encylopedia .

classes.label: Report
classes.comment: A document describing an account or statement describing in detail an event, situation, or the like, usually as the result of observation, inquiry, etc..

classes.label: Series
classes.comment: A loose, thematic, collection of Documents, often Books.

classes.label: Slide
classes.comment: A slide in a slideshow

classes.label: Slideshow
classes.comment: A presentation of a series of slides, usually presented in front of an audience with written text and images.

classes.label: Standard
classes.comment: A document describing a standard

classes.label: Statute
classes.comment: A bill enacted into law.

classes.label: Thesis
classes.comment: A document created to summarize research findings associated with the completion of an academic degree.

classes.label: Thesis degree
classes.comment: The academic degree of a Thesis

classes.label: Webpage
classes.comment: A web page is an online document available (at least initially) on the world wide web. A web page is written first and foremost to appear on the web, as distinct from other online resources such as books, manuscripts or audio documents which use the web primarily as a distribution mechanism alongside other more traditional methods such as print.

classes.label: Website
classes.comment: A group of Webpages accessible on the Web.

classes.label: Workshop
classes.comment: A seminar, discussion group, or the like, that emphasizes zxchange of ideas and the demonstration and application of techniques, skills, etc.

properties.label: affirmedBy
properties.comment: A legal decision that affirms a ruling.

properties.label: annotates
properties.comment: Critical or explanatory note for a Document.

properties.label: list of authors
properties.comment: An ordered list of authors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order authors by importance.

properties.label: cited by
properties.comment:
Relates a document to another document that cites the
first document.

properties.label: cites
properties.comment:
Relates a document to another document that is cited
by the first document as reference, comment, review, quotation or for
another purpose.

properties.label: list of contributors
properties.comment: An ordered list of contributors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order contributors by importance.

properties.label: court
properties.comment: A court associated with a legal document; for example, that which issues a decision.

properties.label: degree
properties.comment: The thesis degree.

properties.label: director
properties.comment: A Film director.

properties.label: distributor
properties.comment: Distributor of a document or a collection of documents.

properties.label: editor
properties.comment: A person having managerial and sometimes policy-making responsibility for the editorial part of a publishing firm or of a newspaper, magazine, or other publication.

properties.label: list of editors
properties.comment: An ordered list of editors. Normally, this list is seen as a priority list that order editors by importance.

properties.label: interviewee
properties.comment: An agent that is interviewed by another agent.

properties.label: interviewer
properties.comment: An agent that interview another agent.

properties.label: issuer
properties.comment: An entity responsible for issuing often informally published documents such as press releases, reports, etc.

properties.label: organizer
properties.comment: The organizer of an event; includes conference organizers, but also government agencies or other bodies that are responsible for conducting hearings.

properties.label: owner
properties.comment: Owner of a document or a collection of documents.

properties.label: presented at
properties.comment: Relates a document to an event; for example, a paper to a conference.

properties.label: presents
properties.comment: Relates an event to associated documents; for example, conference to a paper.

properties.label: producer
properties.comment: Producer of a document or a collection of documents.

properties.label: recipient
properties.comment: An agent that receives a communication document.

properties.label: reproducedIn
properties.comment: The resource in which another resource is reproduced.

properties.label: reversedBy
properties.comment: A legal decision that reverses a ruling.

properties.label: review of
properties.comment: Relates a review document to a reviewed thing (resource, item, etc.).

properties.label: status
properties.comment: The publication status of (typically academic) content.

properties.label: subsequentLegalDecision
properties.comment: A legal decision on appeal that takes action on a case (affirming it, reversing it, etc.).

properties.label: transcript of
properties.comment: Relates a document to some transcribed original.

properties.label: translation of
properties.comment: Relates a translated document to the original document.

properties.label: translator
properties.comment: A person who translates written document from one language to another.

properties.label: abstract
properties.comment: A summary of the resource.

properties.label: date argued
properties.comment: The date on which a legal case is argued before a court. Date is of format xsd:date

properties.label: chapter
properties.comment: An chapter number

properties.label: content
properties.comment: This property is for a plain-text rendering of the content of a Document. While the plain-text content of an entire document could be described by this property.

properties.label: edition
properties.comment: The name defining a special edition of a document. Normally its a literal value composed of a version number and words.

properties.label: issue
properties.comment: An issue number

properties.label: locator
properties.comment: A description (often numeric) that locates an item within a containing document or collection.

properties.label: number of pages
properties.comment: The number of pages contained in a document

properties.label: number of volumes
properties.comment: The number of volumes contained in a collection of documents (usually a series, periodical, etc.).

properties.label: number
properties.comment: A generic item or document number. Not to be confused with issue number.

properties.label: page end
properties.comment: Ending page number within a continuous page range.

properties.label: page start
properties.comment: Starting page number within a continuous page range.

properties.label: pages
properties.comment: A string of non-contiguous page spans that locate a Document within a Collection. Example: 23-25, 34, 54-56. For continuous page ranges, use the pageStart and pageEnd properties.

properties.label: prefix name
properties.comment: The prefix of a name

properties.label: section
properties.comment: A section number

properties.label: short title
properties.comment: The abbreviation of a title.

properties.label: suffix name
properties.comment: The suffix of a name

properties.label: uri
properties.comment: Universal Resource Identifier of a document

properties.label: volume
properties.comment: A volume number

classes.label: Label Property
classes.comment: A foaf:LabelProperty is any RDF property with texual values that serve as labels.

classes.label: Person
classes.comment: A person.

classes.label: Document
classes.comment: A document.

classes.label: Organization
classes.comment: An organization.

classes.label: Group
classes.comment: A class of Agents.

classes.label: Agent
classes.comment: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

classes.label: Project
classes.comment: A project (a collective endeavour of some kind).

classes.label: Image
classes.comment: An image.

classes.label: PersonalProfileDocument
classes.comment: A personal profile RDF document.

classes.label: Online Account
classes.comment: An online account.

classes.label: Online Gaming Account
classes.comment: An online gaming account.

classes.label: Online E-commerce Account
classes.comment: An online e-commerce account.

classes.label: Online Chat Account
classes.comment: An online chat account.

properties.label: personal mailbox
properties.comment: A  personal mailbox, ie. an Internet mailbox associated with exactly one owner, the first owner of this mailbox. This is a 'static inverse functional property', in that  there is (across time and change) at most one individual that ever has any particular value for foaf:mbox.

properties.label: sha1sum of a personal mailbox URI name
properties.comment: The sha1sum of the URI of an Internet mailbox associated with exactly one owner, the  first owner of the mailbox.

properties.label: gender
properties.comment: The gender of this Agent (typically but not necessarily 'male' or 'female').

properties.label: geekcode
properties.comment: A textual geekcode for this person, see http://www.geekcode.com/geek.html

properties.label: DNA checksum
properties.comment: A checksum for the DNA of some thing. Joke.

properties.label: sha1sum (hex)
properties.comment: A sha1sum hash, in hex.

properties.label: based near
properties.comment: A location that something is based near, for some broadly human notion of near.

properties.label: title
properties.comment: Title (Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr. etc)

properties.label: nickname
properties.comment: A short informal nickname characterising an agent (includes login identifiers, IRC and other chat nicknames).

properties.label: jabber ID
properties.comment: A jabber ID for something.

properties.label: AIM chat ID
properties.comment: An AIM chat ID

properties.label: Skype ID
properties.comment: A Skype ID

properties.label: ICQ chat ID
properties.comment: An ICQ chat ID

properties.label: Yahoo chat ID
properties.comment: A Yahoo chat ID

properties.label: MSN chat ID
properties.comment: An MSN chat ID

properties.label: name
properties.comment: A name for some thing.

properties.label: firstName
properties.comment: The first name of a person.

properties.label: lastName
properties.comment: The last name of a person.

properties.label: Given name
properties.comment: The given name of some person.

properties.label: Given name
properties.comment: The given name of some person.

properties.label: Surname
properties.comment: The surname of some person.

properties.label: family_name
properties.comment: The family name of some person.

properties.label: familyName
properties.comment: The family name of some person.

properties.label: phone
properties.comment: A phone,  specified using fully qualified tel: URI scheme (refs: http://www.w3.org/Addressing/schemes.html#tel).

properties.label: homepage
properties.comment: A homepage for some thing.

properties.label: weblog
properties.comment: A weblog of some thing (whether person, group, company etc.).

properties.label: openid
properties.comment: An OpenID for an Agent.

properties.label: tipjar
properties.comment: A tipjar document for this agent, describing means for payment and reward.

properties.label: plan
properties.comment: A .plan comment, in the tradition of finger and '.plan' files.

properties.label: made
properties.comment: Something that was made by this agent.

properties.label: maker
properties.comment: An agent that  made this thing.

properties.label: image
properties.comment: An image that can be used to represent some thing (ie. those depictions which are particularly representative of something, eg. one's photo on a homepage).

properties.label: depiction
properties.comment: A depiction of some thing.

properties.label: depicts
properties.comment: A thing depicted in this representation.

properties.label: thumbnail
properties.comment: A derived thumbnail image.

properties.label: myersBriggs
properties.comment: A Myers Briggs (MBTI) personality classification.

properties.label: workplace homepage
properties.comment: A workplace homepage of some person; the homepage of an organization they work for.

properties.label: work info homepage
properties.comment: A work info homepage of some person; a page about their work for some organization.

properties.label: schoolHomepage
properties.comment: A homepage of a school attended by the person.

properties.label: knows
properties.comment: A person known by this person (indicating some level of reciprocated interaction between the parties).

properties.label: interest
properties.comment: A page about a topic of interest to this person.

properties.label: topic_interest
properties.comment: A thing of interest to this person.

properties.label: publications
properties.comment: A link to the publications of this person.

properties.label: current project
properties.comment: A current project this person works on.

properties.label: past project
properties.comment: A project this person has previously worked on.

properties.label: funded by
properties.comment: An organization funding a project or person.

properties.label: logo
properties.comment: A logo representing some thing.

properties.label: topic
properties.comment: A topic of some page or document.

properties.label: primary topic
properties.comment: The primary topic of some page or document.

properties.label: focus
properties.comment: The underlying or 'focal' entity associated with some SKOS-described concept.

properties.label: is primary topic of
properties.comment: A document that this thing is the primary topic of.

properties.label: page
properties.comment: A page or document about this thing.

properties.label: theme
properties.comment: A theme.

properties.label: account
properties.comment: Indicates an account held by this agent.

properties.label: account
properties.comment: Indicates an account held by this agent.

properties.label: account service homepage
properties.comment: Indicates a homepage of the service provide for this online account.

properties.label: account name
properties.comment: Indicates the name (identifier) associated with this online account.

properties.label: member
properties.comment: Indicates a member of a Group

properties.label: membershipClass
properties.comment: Indicates the class of individuals that are a member of a Group

properties.label: birthday
properties.comment: The birthday of this Agent, represented in mm-dd string form, eg. '12-31'.

properties.label: age
properties.comment: The age in years of some agent.

properties.label: status
properties.comment: A string expressing what the user is happy for the general public (normally) to know about their current activity.
